notes: Posted 18 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.
Published title 'Why I Beat Steven Lewis's Girlfriend' not used as the page title: it reads as a joke about hitting a named real person's girlfriend; the page is credited Mike Gemme DS.

Starting cards as posted under START - 3: Combat Readiness, Tatooine: Desert Landing Site ('Maul's Landing Site') and Tatooine: Jabba's Palace (posted 'Jabba's Palace Jabba's Palace'); these count toward the 60. Total 60. No Objective; the strategy starts Maul's site with Jabba's Palace via Combat Readiness.
The description says this is the Tatooine mains deck the poster and 'steebo' used at Ramapo (RamapoCon III); the post gives no finish or record. The postscript says steebo built the deck.

Posted 'Jabba's Ho Desposal Unit' matches no Jabba's Palace site (the Jabba's Palace sites are Antechamber, Audience Chamber, Droid Workshop, Dungeon, Entrance Cavern, Lower Passages, Rancor Pit); kept as written.

Posted 'Jabba's Ho Chamber' dested Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber (Dark) (the strategy says to save the Audience Chamber for last); 'jabba's Entrance Cavern' and 'Jabba's Ho Dungeon' dested the Dark Entrance Cavern and Dungeon pages; 'Jabba's Droid workshop' Jabba's Palace: Droid Workshop.

Surname-first names: 'Maul, Darth' dested the Tatooine Darth Maul; 'Vader, Darth DLOTS' Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'Vader, Darth Lord' the Special Edition Lord Vader; 'Jade, Mara' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'Sing, Aurra' Aurra Sing; 'Evazan, Dr AKA Rooboo AKA Dr. Cornelius' Dr. Evazan; 'Tarkin, Wilhulf' Grand Moff Tarkin; 'Fett, Boba w/ blaster rifle' Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; 'Xizor, Prince' Prince Xizor.
Posted 'Omni Box/ It's worse' dested Ommni Box & It's Worse; 'Sniper/ Dark Strike' Sniper & •Dark Strike; 'Disarmed' the Dark Disarmed page; Secret Plans is a 2001 Effect (not a Defensive Shield).
